checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Headline reads exactly 'Bring home some green'
Multiple lush potted houseplants against cream background
must.why: Plants are plentiful but set in a busy photo scene, with cream only in the text bands.
Headline is large and clear, though wrong text.
Extra bottom line 'Come find your new plant friend' appears.

faults.what: Headline text is wrong: 'Fresh Green Arrivals' instead of 'Bring home some green'
Extra unrequested tagline 'Come find your new plant friend'
Background is a busy shelf scene rather than a cream background

summary: A clean, attractive square plant-shop post came out, but it has the wrong headline ('Fresh Green Arrivals'), an extra tagline, and a busy photo scene in place of a cream background.
